title: Efficacy and Safety Graphics for Clinical Review Packages
text: Data simulated. describe trial results. Build full gallery package root:
code: library(trialfigs)  onc <- simulate_oncology(n_per_arm = 80)  plot_km(   onc$adsl,   time = "os_months", event = "os_event", arm = "arm",   title = "Overall survival",   xlab = "Months", ylab = "Overall survival" )  plot_waterfall(onc$adsl) plot_swimmer(onc$adsl, max_n = 24) plot_spider(onc$adtr)  forest <- rbind(   cox_hr(onc$adsl, "os_months", "os_event", "arm", subgroup = "Overall"),   cox_hr(onc$adsl[onc$adsl$sex == "F", ], "os_months", "os_event", "arm", subgroup = "Female"),   cox_hr(onc$adsl[onc$adsl$sex == "M", ], "os_months", "os_event", "arm", subgroup = "Male") ) plot_forest(forest, n = "n", title = "Overall survival by subgroup")  saf <- simulate_safety() plot_ae(saf$adae, denom = saf$adsl, reference = "Placebo") plot_edish(saf$adlb) plot_exposure(saf$adsl) source("inst/examples/run_all.R") # PNGs land in inst/examples/figures/
